static_comparison: unchanged; no static150 head or transform initializes this learner
ordering: SHA256 of literal v776-online + original qid, ascending hexadecimal digest

donors.mapping: numpy default_rng(seed).choice(sorted initialization roster, size=50, replace=True) in frozen stream order
donors.labels: already-known initialization A1 labels; matching original sibling positions
donors.changed_labels: retain numerator, denominator and fraction against released stream truth; never select the map using truth

initialization.input: independently L2-normalized question and answer embeddings, concatenated in that order
initialization.transform: initialization-only population mean/std; constants scale1; Gaussian projection seed775084 with std1/sqrt(27); initialization projected min/max to[-1,1], constants0; later clip
initialization.basis: intercept +27 linear +189 cubic fixed-knot columns; spline_basis_8986.design
initialization.optimizer: L-BFGS-B from zeros; maxiter2000, gtol1e-7, ftol1e-12

update_equations.siblings: three original sibling positions in order; one proposal per released qid
update_equations.guard: all150 original CAL rows; Brier increase<=0.005 and classification-error increase<=0 against arm initial state
update_equations.reject: restore coefficients and accumulator; still acknowledge feedback

causality.prediction: seal all15 sibling/arm predictions before releasing group g-1
causality.tail: drain group5 after all predictions; cannot improve preceding scores
causality.reset: identical initial coefficients and zero accumulators for every stream
causality.retention: no labels in learner request; seal end-of-stream predictions before evaluation

recovery.snapshot: complete coefficients, accumulators, pending items, acknowledgments, prediction and feedback rows
recovery.commit: write temporary snapshot, flush/fsync, atomic replace, directory fsync; acknowledge after commit
recovery.comparison: exact complete state equality including retained prediction rows

benefit_bounds.resampling: paired stream-bootstrap; per-qid retention changes averaged across streams also reported
benefit_bounds.small_sample_caution: Ten streams have limited power; intervals condition on the fixed initial fit, guard and retention. Repeated retention contains100 unique qids, not1000. Null results do not authorize tuning bounds or universal architecture-failure claims.
benefit_bounds.learning_signal_score: all six bounds plus exact recovery; methods readiness requires no scientific win

fixtures.positive: constructed online all-one labels and fixed features with separable guard support
fixtures.no_signal: seeded independent Bernoulli labels on the same fixed features
fixtures.scope: CPU mechanics only; no human benefit, independent generalization or ARC solve
